Hunt: Showdown 1896은 탈출 슈팅 장르의 새로운 시대를 여는 중독적이고 가차없는 게임입니다. 역사에서 잊혀진 타락한 벽지에서 혼자 또는 친구들과 함께 시간을 초월한 악에 맞서 싸우세요. 뒤틀린 괴물과 다른 무자비한 헌터들을 넘어서야만 현상금을 손에 넣을 수 있습니다. 헌트가 당신을 집어삼키는 동안 모든 것을 거세요.

A Fresh Contract: Nominate Hunt for Labor of Love
2026년 11월 23일
Hunters, there’s a fresh contract in the Book, and the target is the Steam Awards.
Eight years of mud, blood and gunsmoke, and 2026 was one of our biggest yet. Update 2.7 opened Devil’s Trail. Update 2.8 launched Road to Hell alongside the inventory slot rework, new Strongholds and level design improvements. Update 2.9 brought Blood Testament, a new Boss, a new shotgun and a round of balance changes.
If Hunt has earned it, mark us for Labor of Love with the Nominate button above before 30 Nov, 10:00 PT (19:00 CET). Whatever the bounty, thank you for a hell of a year in the bayou.

기록상 2,462.6시간
게시 일시: 2026년 11월 23일
I've been playing Hunt: Showdown for over 4 years and have accumulated more than 2,000 hours. It's a game I always find myself coming back to, especially when playing with friends. I don't play much solo, as I find the experience much more enjoyable with a group.
If you're new, I'd recommend starting with Soul Survivor to learn the maps, get comfortable with the mechanics, and pick up some of the basics before jumping into Bounty Hunt trios. It's also a great way to get started if you don't have teammates lined up for duos or trios.
Like any game, Hunt has its pros and cons, and it definitely has a learning curve. But if you're willing to put in the time, it's a rewarding experience with plenty of memorable moments. It's a game I'll always come back to for more bayou chaos with friends!
